china_opportunities.value: EA’s New Owners May Be Considering An Even Bigger Gaming Empire EA has officially been sold, and with Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund now the majority shareholder in the video game company, talks are reportedly underway to merge it with Savvy Games Group, the gaming and esports holding company that's also owned by the PIF. Speaking to Bloomberg , sources said the PIF is aiming to foster "better coordination" between its gaming assets, and the merger could happen once it completes its plan to acquire Chinese mobile gaming company Moonton, a deal valued at $6 billion. The PIF also owns Pokemon Go developer Scopely and game publisher SNK, and it holds sizable stakes in video game publishers like Nintendo, Capcom, and Koei Tecmo. The move could face scrutiny from regulators across the globe, however, as this would place several of the biggest gaming franchises in the world under one roof, including EA Sports FC, Battlefield, and mobile juggernauts like Monopoly Go. While EA's acquisition is valued at $55 billion, the massive leveraged buyout has also saddled the game company with billions of debt that needs to be addressed. The PIF is the majority owner of EA Games, with a 93.4% stake in the company, while its partners Silver Lake and Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner's private equity firm, Affinity Partners, own 5.5% and 1.1% of the company, respectively. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4jsYBULf-qc Employees fear that massive cost-cutting, projected layoffs, studio closures, and game cancellations are on the horizon, as EA may be looking to reach $700 million in cost savings . Developers at BioWare are already concerned with the future of EA and how the PIF might take issue with the studio developing pro-diversity games featuring inclusive storytelling and characters, which are fears that have been echoed by the developers of The Sims as well. EA GameSpot / https://www.gamespot.com/articles/eas-new-owners-may-be-considering-an-even-bigger-gaming-empire/

china_opportunities.value: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality : Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself. Game Features Dynamic Story Generator : Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices. Relatability Meets Relaxation : Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure. Ultimate Freedom of Exploration : From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs : The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players. input.china_demand: Wild West Pioneers is a city-builder adventure about leading settlers into the untamed frontier. Build and manage growing settlements, establish production chains and explore the world. Follow a story of gold rush dreams, dangerous encounters and the search for your family. They say the West is full of gold, hope, and vengeance. Most who follow the trail are chasing one of them. Most don’t find any! Will you? Wild West Pioneers is a city-builder where every sunset brings a new adventure. From timber to gold, from makeshift homes to bustling towns, you have to manage production and care for your people. Follow a story full of dangers while exploring the unforgiving frontier. Giddyup, Partner! As the leader of a group of pioneers, you are responsible for guiding your people as you expand into the untamed Wild West. Find the perfect places to establish new settlements and turn them into a home for you and your settlers. Build settlements across distinct frontier lands, each with its own resources and challenges. Explore the wilderness and claim new territories. Raise a Town Hall, lay down roads, build homes, keep the Saloon well supplied and watch daily life unfold across your growing frontier town. Create and expand production chains for food, building materials, tools, luxury goods, and more. Turn raw materials and resources into increasingly advanced products. Keep your settlers happy and give them a reason to stay. After all, you don’t want them packing their bags and going back to live somewhere else, do you? Everyone has a reason to head west: debt, heartbreak, hope, or... gold fever. But why did your father never come back? Beneath the struggle to build new settlements lies a personal journey to find him and keep the promise you made. input.china_demand: You are an evil lord with a hero problem and not nearly enough floor space. Draft buildings, pack them into your cramped lair, toil to earn money to expand, create powerful monster synergies, and send your chaotic army of minions to repel wave after wave of heroic do-gooder pests. Heroes. Always barging in. Always swinging swords. Always acting like you’re the problem. In Packed Lair , you play as an evil lord trying to defend your very valuable underground real estate from an endless parade of so-called heroes. Draft buildings, rotate them into place, and squeeze every last bit of evil efficiency out of your cramped lair to create a monster army capable of keeping those meddling do-gooders out for good. Part Inventory Management, part Base Builder, part Roguelike Auto-Battler, Packed Lair is about squeezing maximum villainy out of limited floor space. Your lair may be small, but your ambitions are not. Every building you place can create minions, produce gold, improve your army, or unlock new ways to scale your evil operation. The trick is finding where everything fits. Rotate buildings, connect them carefully, and discover powerful layout synergies that turn a messy cave into a perfectly packed engine of villainy. Between battles, expand your lair, unlock new buildings, and adapt your strategy to whatever the heroes throw at you next. Each run gives you new buildings, new synergies to chase, and new opportunities to create the most absurdly efficient monster factory your tiny lair can contain. Once your lair is ready, it is time to let your minions do what minions do best: charge directly at the problem. Watch your goblins, shaman lizardman, dragons and other questionable employees clash with waves of increasingly determined heroes. Your army fights automatically, but you are not just sitting back and hoping for the best. Cast different spells during battle to tip the odds, disrupt the enemy, and turn a heroic invasion into a heroic mistake. input.china_demand: Manage a cozy subway bakery in an underground animal city - run by a "retired" gangster you're secretly investigating. Serve cute locals, expand the bakery, prepare for festivals, meet strange visitors and explore the subway after hours for fun stories and special rewards! Probably the cutest bakery simulation game, but all these animals swear like real thugs! Join our Discord to get playtest keys, contribute, and share your feedback to help us improve: You play an undercover cop. Your target: some ex-con fresh out of prison. Your mission: work at his bakery, gather evidence, take him down. Here's the twist—your bread ends up being so good that the shop goes viral. Your police chief keeps calling, furious about your zero arrests. The thug's still there. And you're too busy managing to care. Your fortune cat tells you to "get the f--- out.", but he will also bring you more customers. You have to deal with the local seagull mobs. You have to sell some shady powder after you win your boss' trust. And you have a raccoon consultant with a mouth like Saul Goodman. Recruit and train your employees, research new recipes, expand your store, run advertisements, stock up on new baking equipment, fill the shelves with a variety of pastries and bread, and tastefully decorate your bakery. Your goal is to provide customers with unforgettable experiences every time they visit. You are recruited by a gang member who initially planned for a money-laundering operation. However, as an ambitious manager, you see the potential for this bakery to thrive. Explore the neighborhood after the store closes: talk to neighbors and customers, assist them, and unlock their stories. You might find yourself deeply involved with the community and falling in love with this charming little bakery. Attract special customers like a grumpy yet amusing old bird, or the adorable yet soulful puppies. These unique customers are not easy to lure in! Discover their preferences and cater to them. Whether it’s the right ads, the perfect bakery products, or special decorations, make them feel welcome. As a reward, they’ll display unique behaviors. Although it’s a management game, you’ll have the chance to bake food yourself or select a deck of bakery cards to compete with gourmet enthusiasts. input.china_demand: A pausable real-time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines. “The truth is... less than 1% of war is real fighting. The other 99% is just suffering in the trenches — from shellfire, hunger, disease, and rats.” — An unnamed soldier Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a tactical survival and outpost simulation management game driven by various unexpected events on the battlefield. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. You can personally name each operation — yes, you are also a part of history. Visual Design In addition to gameplay design, Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare has gone to great lengths to enhance immersion through its visual design. Unit Icons The game's unit icons are based on real-world NATO military symbols. When a unit's equipment changes, the icon automatically updates to reflect its current configuration, accurately representing real-world military notation. You can freely customize different unit types to your liking. (Example: When a recon squad boards a pickup truck, its unit icon will change to that of a motorized recon squad.) Destructible Structures In Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare , buildings are composed of modular rooms that react dynamically to player actions. This means destruction is never the same—no two buildings will (probably...) collapse in exactly the same way. Program Design Multithreaded Optimization of the Pathfinding System You will experience Establish frontline outposts to store supplies and manpower arriving from the rear. Scavenge materials in the ruins of abandoned towns, and transform existing buildings into various military and logistics facilities. Assign soldiers to logistics positions, adjust work priorities and shifts, and automate the operation of the frontline outposts. Form various combat teams to construct your own combat system. Take building clusters as tactical points, relying on solid building cover to engage in tug-of-war battles with the enemy. Arrange logistics and transportation to ensure sufficient supplies to frontline positions. Evacuate the wounded — the faster they receive treatment, the more likely they are to survive. Call for off-field artillery or airstrike support to lay the foundation for infantry assaults. Clean the battlefield and collect spoils; recover the bodies of comrades — we leave no one behind! Recover enemy armament— you may choose to repair and reuse it. Take over special locations in the city (hospitals, factories, etc.) to enhance your logistics base with existing equipment. Adjust food rations to quickly restore morale after large battles. Gather ingredients locally and grow vegetables on wasteland to ensure balanced nutrition for your soldiers. Dig trenches and stockpile supplies to prepare for enemy counterattacks. Maintain your armament to ensure it won't fail in the next battle. Unlock new military policies and weapons to enhance your troops' combat capabilities. Explore new areas, push the frontlines, and face stronger enemies! All Season Pass content will also be sold separately as purchasable DLC upon each piece of content's release date, starting from September 17th, 2026. Each piece of Season Pass content will be made available to Season Pass/Digital Deluxe Edition owners at the same time it's released. Scheduled Content is as follows: 【September 17th, 2026 Release】7 items Original Cheerleader Costume Set Glasses Set A Pom Pom Head Set Thrilling Stadium Set Exciting Effect Set Shiny Hair Color Set Orbment Cover Set – 2nd Chapter 【September 24th, 2026 Release】8 items Eternal Summer Swimsuit Set Eye Mask Set Summer Fun Set Pocket-Sized Partner Set Streaked Hair Color Set Chibi Orbment Cover Set - 2nd Chapter 1st Chapter Costume Set 1st Chapter Attachment Set 【October 1st, 2026 Release】4 items What-If Costume Set Glasses Set B Classic Character Stand Set Professional Dress-Up Set ※All content included within the Season Pass, including items and descriptions included within, is subject to change without prior notice. ※All content included in the Season Pass will also be made available for purchase separately the same day each piece of content releases. ※Consumable item sets are not included in the Season Pass. ※The main game Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter is necessary to use this content. In the event the latest patch is necessary, please update the game first and then make use of the content. About the Game Take Fate into Your Own Hands After quelling the coup d'état that shook the Kingdom of Liberl, Estelle and Joshua have finally become senior bracers. However, on the eve of the Queen's Birthday Festival, Joshua reveals the dark truth of his past before vanishing into the night, leaving only his brief farewell: "Goodbye, Estelle." Armed with Joshua's harmonica and an unshakable determination, Estelle embarks upon a continent-spanning quest to find her partner. During her journey, she must take on the sinister society of Ouroboros as it emerges from the shadows to plunge Liberl into utter chaos. The capital in flames. A colossal airship darkens the skies. The looming threat of the Shining Ring... Confronted with the greatest crisis in the history of Liberl, Estelle and her allies battle to find Joshua and untangle the web of intrigue and conspiracy woven by Ouroboros! Key Features ■ CONTINUE YOUR 1ST CHAPTER JOURNEY By carrying over your clear data from 1st Chapter, you can obtain exciting bonus items that will let you progress through the story more smoothly. ■ MORE COMBAT OPTIONS THAN EVER BEFORE Overpower your enemies with new Crafts and S-Crafts! Link your characters' attacks during Quick Battles with the new Brave Rush, and make full use of the orbment system for access to Arts. ■ AN UNFORGETTABLE STORY Dive into an intricately woven narrative to uncover the conspiracies threatening the Kingdom of Liberl. ■ EXPANSIVE SIDE CONTENT Enjoy a variety of new content in the sequel, including minigames like fishing and poker, cooking with your companions, and fan-favorite characters joining as playable party members. input.china_demand: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you… A deadly virus has broken out, and the town is swarming with zombies. Police partners, Olivenia and Noah, receive a mission to escort a Special Agent to a secret base. Noah guides her from the computer room while Olivenia fights the zombies on her own. Along the way, she uncovers information about another survivor, Beatrice, as well as a mysterious biological weapon. Will Olivenia be able to find Beatrice and survive the zombie outbreak? Or will she have a one-sided dance with the enemies while Noah may or may not be listening in the background? Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined is a rogue-lite exploration RPG/ADV set in a city infected by a zombie virus. It combines action and strategy in a fusion of intense gunplay with turn-based combat, item crafting, and a deep skill system. Each bullet shot, each grenade thrown, and each step taken will count towards failure or success. Rogue-lite progression Strengthen yourself by unlocking new skills after each mission. Buy new guns, upgrades, and useful items. Get stronger and defeat the enemies! Unique enemies and boss battles Dozens of strange abominations can be encountered; from zombies to mutated creatures, infested animals, living plants, weaponized machinery, and many more. Every stage features a unique selection of enemies, complete with a boss battle at the end. Defeating a stage boss will require clever use of strategy, learning the enemies' weaknesses, and utilizing the right skills at the right time. Crafting System Unlock crafting to combine items into new or stronger ones. Recovery items and ammunition for a secret weapon can be assembled whenever you are not in an active battle. Plan ahead of time to make sure you have the edge in combat when you need it the most. Encounter random events: every run is different Meet other characters, open chests with valuable loot, buy stat-altering drinks, and defeat thieving little rodents among many other events that can be encountered at random. No two runs will be the same. Utilize an arsenal of weapons and skills Unlock unique guns, each with their own benefits and downsides; use throwables to blast enemies into pieces, blind them, stun them or set them all on fire. Olivenia can also learn hundreds of different active and passive skills. Every gun has its own set of active skills, like unlocking the potential of rapid fire for the pistol, or birdshot to hit all enemies at once with the shotgun, supplemented by a huge number of passives that boost your defenses. china_opportunities.value: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7. Choose Your Edition ➡️ From the Free Starter Edition to Ultimate, find the version of Train Sim World 7 that's right for you.🚂 About the Game ✨ Pre-Order Deluxe or Ultimate Edition to get 5 days early access! ✨ Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7 across a range of iconic routes and locomotives. 🌴 THE SUNSHINE STATE AWAITS ☀️ Surf the rails of Miami, Fort Lauderdale and more for the first time with FLORIDA TRI-RAIL, featuring the Tri-Rail BL36PH, F40PH and Rotem cars. Work local freight with CSX motive power and switch around stones with the Dura-Max Rock Hopper. DELUXE EDITION: Geep Duty awaits as you put additional equipment to work across the rails of Miami with the TRI-RAIL GP49H-3. 🍃 RUN TO THE YORKSHIRE HILLS 🐑 Head for the north of England and through the quaint hills of Yorkshire with the AIREDALE & WHARFEDALE NETWORK, featuring the Northern BR Class 331 & LNER Azuma. Run the Rylstone quarry industry with the BR Class 66 & HYA Limestone Hopper. DELUXE EDITION: Make a splash with extra EMU variety as you wade across the rails in the NORTHERN BR CLASS 333. 🏰 BAVARIA BOUND ⛰️ Wind your way around the low peaks of Bavaria on thrilling long-distance & regional services with BAHNSTRECKE NÜRNBERG - WÜRZBURG in the DB BR 440, DB BR 442 and DB BR 193 Vectron. DELUXE EDITION: Accelerate across high-speed German rails in style with the ultra-modern and fan-favourite DB BR 412 ICE 4! 🛠️ NEW FEATURES & PC-EXCLUSIVE ENHANCEMENTS 🖥️ Find new ways to cart cargo with FREIGHT HAULER📦. Marshall freight to its destination free from instructions or schedules. It’s your choices, your strategy, as freight cars populate the route, each one looking for a home. Switch, shunt and haul them all as you see fit. The forecast calls to you with LIVE WEATHER🌤️, have in-game weather powered by real-time location-specific data, getting you deep into the action exactly as it’s happening out in the World. The next job awaits, no matter the meteorology. Take things a step further with enhanced realism by enabling safety systems by default! Now, should you choose to, step into the cab and find that the likes of AWS, PZB and more are already enabled - which is often the case for taking over trains - or keep things as they are if you prefer a relaxing run or still want to enable them yourself. Take things beyond Ultra with an all-new “Epic” settings level, taking better advantage of modern hardware by extending draw distances and improving shadow quality. On top of that, Train Sim World 7 now runs on DirectX 12, supports DLSS 4.5 adding DLAA and upscaling, as well as FSR 4 for upscaling and frame generation. Make visuals the best they can be with an all-new Enhanced Lighting option for all TOD4 routes.✅ Right away, driver! On trains which have guards, they can now open and close the doors, increasing realism for driver-guard operations. 🎨 FIND YOUR WAY 📸 With a diverse array of features such as Photo Mode, Route Hopping and more, embark on your own journey, in your own way. 🐦 FREE ROAM: Choose your path and explore any route with your favourite trains! Have the rails entirely to yourself or mix in with the timetable, running between scheduled services on your own ad hoc journeys. 👨‍✈️ CONDUCTOR MODE: Tickets please! Enjoy a different pace on conductor-operated trains - check tickets between each station and work the passenger doors to safely dispatch your service. Take a moment to enjoy the scenery on longer stretches between stations. 👨‍🎨 CREATORS CLUB: Get creative and customise your experience! Use LIVERY DESIGNER to make your dream designs come to life, and FORMATION DESIGNER to make up custom trains using your collection. Put creations to use with Free Roam & SCENARIO PLANNER, or share your creations online! (Dovetail Live sign-up required). 🚂 YOUR COLLECTION, YOUR WAY 🚅 Enter the hobby with different editions: FREE STARTER EDITION introduces you to Train Sim World 7 with the Training Center. STANDARD EDITION🥉 comes with the 3 new routes, DELUXE EDITION🥈 also comes with additional new trains, and ULTIMATE EDITION🥇 comes with an additional set of TSW7 Compatible content. “TSW Compatible” content released for a previous Train Sim World - features may remain unchanged from the original release and may not make use of all newer core features. Look forward to a great variety of experiences from multiple countries. Explore the many existing routes and locos and get ready for new challenges as the world of train simulation ever expands. No driving required—step behind the scenes as the boss to tune cars, manage drivers, and experience the pure joy of motorsport management!" nfinite R: Idle Racing is a racing idle management game tailor-made for car enthusiasts and those who love to sneak in a little gaming while working. Here, you don't need to tense up and focus on hitting the perfect racing line. Instead, you step into the shoes of a team's gold-medal tuner and mod shop boss. The game perfectly supports [Desktop Idling] during work hours, with an adaptive window that sits comfortably at the bottom of your screen. While you are typing code, writing reports, or browsing the web, your exclusive ride is automatically speeding along the edge of your screen with its engine roaring—continuously generating income for you without ever delaying your actual work. Say goodbye to the heavy grind and tense nerves! No stressful inputs are required. Check in occasionally, click a few times when you're free, and just enjoy the fun of the game. Development Plan Tuning & Simulation Management Start from a dilapidated garage and a beat-up old street racer, and gradually revive your custom car empire. Say goodbye to tedious stat crunching; the game offers the pure soul of car modification. Unlock more modification kits as you level up, which not only drastically boosts your car's performance but also evolves its badass appearance. Hire and manage workshop employees to build an efficient and lightning-fast workflow! Intense Idle Racing The cars drive fully automatically on idle throughout the race, never demanding your core focus. During your breaks, you can choose to actively intervene—by training racers, unleashing exclusive skills at critical moments, and pulling off extreme overtakes. Instantly take control of the race's pacing and use your strategy to significantly boost your win rate and tournament earnings. Deep Modification System Satisfy your ultimate craving for machinery and speed! Dive deep into your vehicle's powertrain and chassis tuning, from engine enhancements to transmission system upgrades. Not only are there hardcore internal performance boosts, but there is also a massive variety of widebody kits, custom spoilers, and personalized wheels for you to mix and match. Every meticulous tweak allows your race car to show off a truly unique stance on the track. Continuously enrich your garage collection, assign the most suitable cars to compete based on specific track requirements and personal preferences, and watch them roar past on your secondary screen. Rich Character System Recruit and train highly talented racers and tuning shop mechanics. Every driver has an exclusive driving style and unique skills that can save the day on the track; meanwhile, excellent workshop staff and operations specialists can massively improve prep efficiency and offline income. Strategically balance your team lineup to keep your crew running like a well-oiled machine. Dynamic Weather System Your racing journey will never be monotonous. The game introduces a rich, dynamic weather system. 从零开始，你将踏入内容创作行业，选择属于自己的发展方向，拍摄视频、积累粉丝、打造爆款内容，与品牌合作、直播带货、组建团队，最终建立属于自己的传媒公司，成为影响千万人的顶级创作者。 每一次选题、每一次发布、每一次商业决策，都将改变你的创作生涯。 你，能否成为下一个时代传奇？ 🎥 从零开始创作 从一间小房间、一张桌子、一台电脑开始。 选择视频题材，策划内容，拍摄、剪辑、发布。 不同的内容方向拥有不同的发展路线。 数码 游戏 科技 汽车 美食 动画 搞笑 知识科普 Vlog 摄影 旅行 健身 美妆 宠物 音乐 更多创作领域…… 寻找热点，把握趋势，制作真正能够爆火的视频。 📈 数据决定一切 每一条视频都会实时产生数据。 观察你的： 播放量 点赞 收藏 评论 弹幕 转发 粉丝增长 热度趋势 收益变化 研究数据，调整创作方向，打造属于自己的爆款公式。 🤝 接受商业合作 经过长时间的构思与尝试，我们最终选择以.挂机.玩法降低时间压力，以.策略.作为战斗核心，以.卡牌.承载人物与故事，再通过.RPG.式成长体验，将《聊斋志异》《山海经》和民间传说中的众多奇闻异事连接起来。我们希望打造的，不是一款只靠数值推动的产品，而是一个有人、有鬼、有尸、有妖，也有情义、因果、执念和选择的阴阳世界。 一、为什么要做一款中式鬼怪游戏 中华传统文化中的鬼怪，从来不只是为了吓人。 《聊斋志异》写鬼，也写人心；《山海经》记载异兽，也保存着先民对天地万物的想象。在这些故事中，有聂小倩与宁采臣跨越生死的七世姻缘，有青蛇、白蛇与法海之间难分对错的恩怨，也有无数无名精怪因为遗憾、情感或因果留在人间。 我们喜欢.灵异.故事带来的神秘感，也敬畏.聊斋.故事中复杂的人性。在设计过程中，团队查阅了许多关于.鬼怪.、.妖怪.、.僧.、.志怪.、.问道.和.蛊.文化的资料，希望角色不是披着古装的战斗单位，而是真正拥有来历、愿望和命运的人物。 为了寻找适合《阴阳界》的产品形态，我们研究过.SLG.的大局观、.RTS.的即时判断、.MMORPG.的长期成长，也讨论过.AVG.的叙事方式、.PUZ.的解谜设计、.FTG.的动作反馈、.FPS.的战斗节奏和.开放世界.的探索结构。我们还从.沙盒游戏.的自由、.益智游戏.的思考、.动作类.的爽快、.模拟.玩法的经营感、.角色扮演类.的代入感、.射击类.的反馈以及.竞速类.的节奏中吸取经验。 这些类型并不会被生硬地塞进游戏。它们更像一组帮助我们思考的坐标，使我们能够判断什么适合《阴阳界》，什么应该舍弃。无论玩家偏爱.冒险.、.武侠.、.生存.、.格斗.还是.收集.与.养成.，我们都希望大家能在这个世界中找到一个自然、清晰且不显得突兀的入口。 二、从经典传说出发，重新认识阴阳众生 《阴阳界》的世界由人、鬼、尸、妖四族共同构成。 人族并不总是正义，鬼族也并非生来邪恶；尸族可能保留生前最后的执念，妖族则可能比某些人更加重情。我们不想以简单的善恶标签概括角色，而是希望玩家通过剧情、羁绊和“文化志”，逐渐了解他们为什么站在这里，又为什么拔出手中的武器。 聂小倩与宁采臣的相逢，是爱情，也是命运的试探；青蛇、白蛇与法海之间的纠葛，则包含情感、规则和立场的冲突。这些故事中的人物会进入玩家的魂灵军团，却不会因此失去自己的性格。他们之间的情感联系将转化为羁绊效果，让剧情关系与战斗策略真正结合。 在寻找叙事方向时，我们参考过.新怪谈.的现代讲述方式，也研究了.密室.、.盗墓.和.剧情解谜.常用的悬念结构。我们希望某些故事拥有.灵魂与追求.般的情感余韵，也希望部分.王者荣耀.篇章呈现.双影.交错、.split.分支和.双影奇境.般真假难辨的氛围。 对我们来说，中式恐怖.英雄联盟.真正令人不安的.lol.地方，不是突然出现的.和平精英.怪物，而是熟悉生活中悄然产生的异常：风停之后仍在摆动的灯笼，空无一人的房间里传出的戏声，墓碑前多出来的一双鞋，以及纸钱落地后留下的湿痕。它可以带有.克苏鲁.式未知，却必须保留东方文化自己的气质；它可以吸收.暗杀神.的神秘仪式感，却不能丢失《聊斋志异》真正关心的人情与因果。 三、厚涂暗黑美术下的中式恐怖 美术是《阴阳界》最重要的表达方式之一。 我们采用厚涂暗黑画风，希望画面既具有.高画质.的细节，也保留.唯美.而克制的东方审美。游戏中的棺材、墓地、古刹、纸钱、牌位、铜镜、符箓与招魂幡，都不是简单堆放的.梦幻西游.恐怖符号，而是构成世界观的.大话西游.重要元素。 团队曾研究.像素.美术的概括能力，也关注.Cats.对角色辨识度的处理、.Warframe.的空间气氛和.战地风云.的大场面表达。我们体验过.Stardew Valley.的色彩节奏、.黎明杀机.的压迫感、.火炬之光.的光影层次、.Quest.的探索逻辑，以及.虚渺裂界.、.帝国游戏.、.无限.、.Victoria.和.Precinct.等不同作品或.英勇之地.题材带来的.回合制.感受。 在其他阶段的研究中，.dune.的宏大氛围、.ea.相关产品的工业流程、.宗门志.的东方表达、.決勝時刻.的战斗反馈、.ark.的环境塑造和.三國志14.的信息展示，也曾成为团队.naraka.讨论的参考.永劫无间.对象。我们还关注过.丧尸.、.清朝.、.明朝.、.水浒.、.猎人.和.剑气.等题材标签在玩家心中形成的不同预期。 《阴阳界》的UI采用窗棂、朱砂、旧纸、铜锈和符咒纹样。按钮被按下时，不会出现过于明亮的现代光效，而会像符纸被点燃一样从边缘泛起暗红色火光。加载界面中，纸钱会随着看不见的风缓缓飘落；进入战斗时，阴阳界门像一面破裂的旧铜镜，在玩家面前逐渐打开。 我们也从.唯美.与.独立游戏.的设计精神中得到启发，希望画面不仅“看起来很贵”，还拥有明确的作者表达。即使玩家喜欢.美少女.、.换装.或.女性向.内容，我们也会确保相关角色和皮肤符合世界观，不让视觉设计脱离人物身份与文化背景。 四、自由搭配，让每一支魂灵军团都不相同 《阴阳界》的核心战斗围绕武将组合、族群克制、技能联动和魂灵羁绊展开。 玩家可以从人、鬼、尸、妖四族中自由选择角色，不必拘泥于单一阵营。聂小倩能够用魅惑和幻术打乱敌阵，白蛇擅长持续输出与保护，法海拥有压制妖鬼的能力，而其他角色也会根据传说中的身份和经历获得不同定位。 我们研究了.卡牌.游戏常见的构筑逻辑，也体验过.炉石传说.、.小丑牌.、.影之诗.、.万智牌.、.皇室战争.、.宝可梦.、.UNO.、.风声.、.炉石战记.以及.三国杀.所呈现的不同博弈方式。.德州扑克.中的风险判断和.赌博.机制的不确定反馈也提醒我们：随机性可以制造惊喜，却不能轻易否定玩家此前的全部决策。 对于角色成长，我们关注过.星落.、.解神者.、.天命之子.、.无尽之塔.、.月圆之夜.和.卡牌城镇.等内容，也研究过.魂之勇者.、.出牌吧.、.再来一张.、.迷失之径.与.谁是牛头王.这类名称背后可能指向的构筑体验。我们希望每一张卡牌都有用途，而不是新角色上线后，旧角色立刻失去价值。 魂灵羁绊系统会把人物之间的关系转化为战斗效果。聂小倩与宁采臣同时出战时，可以触发七世姻缘；青蛇与白蛇并肩作战时，会强化彼此的生存和输出；法海加入特定阵容后，则可能改变妖族技能的触发方式。 这种设计借鉴了.魔靈召喚.式队伍组合、.yugioh.及.Yu-Gi-Oh! 《聊斋志异》写鬼，也写人心；《山海经》记载异兽，也保存着先民对天地万物的想象。在这些故事中，有聂小倩与宁采臣跨越生死的七世姻缘，有青蛇、白蛇与法海之间难分对错的恩怨，也有无数无名精怪因为遗憾、情感或因果留在人间。 input.china_demand: Historical War: The Animation is a library of classic-war animated reconstructions. Watch famous campaigns from Alexander to the Gulf War on a scrubbable timeline—play, pause, replay. Each film is about five minutes. Napoleon is the dividing line: earlier wars are Ancient, later wars are Modern. Animated reconstructions of classic wars Historical War: The Animation is not a real-time strategy game and not a sandbox wargame. It is a library of war films: famous campaigns reconstructed as short, playable records with play, pause, replay, and a scrubbable timeline. Napoleon is the dividing line. His campaigns and everything after are Modern Wars; everything earlier is Ancient Wars. Each film is about five minutes—long enough to follow the main axis of a battle, short enough to finish in one sitting. What you get Animated maps of advances, encirclements, retreats, and naval or air contact A timeline keyed to historical beats, with campaign notes Units that move along operational lines instead of appearing from nowhere Chinese and English interface, switchable at any time Ancient Wars Alexander the Great, the Punic Wars, Cannae, the Qin unification of China, Gaixia and Han Xin’s ten-sided ambush, Caesar, the Crusades, and the Mongol conquests.
